The agent writes drafts and stops there. CLAUDE.md says so, and `.claude/hooks/no-self-approve.py` blocks it. If I made the change, the record would show the agent approving its own spec, and approval is supposed to show that a person signed off.

2. `git add spec/2026-10-19-han-chot-cho-viec.md && git commit -m "spec han-chot-cho-viec: accepted (Thảo)"`
